# Direct PAL100 + Max Detail notice

This package contains no WipEout disc data and no Hueponik replacement engine.
It selects statically linked runtime plugins. The corresponding title changes
in `game.toml` are guarded, whole-instruction AOT replacements derived from the
published option-table semantics: Max ship LOD, 65K ship distance, and High
birds. Track 4x4 remains off by retaining stock behavior.

Hueponik's published patch was used as the behavioral reference. The original
disc remains user-supplied and is authenticated before generation.
